I saved this as a project convention in EngramDB, so other sessions and collaborators will find it when they look up timestamps, timezones or the database layer. It says:

- All database timestamps are stored in UTC.
- Timestamps are converted to the customer's timezone only in the API layer, on the way in and out.
- Storage, queries and business logic all work in UTC. Never write local times to the database or convert to local time below the API layer.
